meta.title: Cones and Popsicles
meta.talk: Tell me about a favorite treat from the county fair.

source.prompt: Minimalist bold-and-easy adult coloring book page of Cones and Popsicles, a fair and carnival food coloring page, thick pure-black vector outlines, clean uncrowded composition, large fillable areas, solid pure white background, zero shading, zero gray tones, high contrast, 3:4 aspect ratio

checks.label: Pure black lines on white: no color, gray, shading or gradients

checks.label: A 3:4 portrait page with the whole subject inside at least 8% of white margin, as large as that allows

checks.label: The traced lines follow the master: no line lost, none made up
checks.detail: 123 areas traced of 126 in the master; ink left out reaches 13.3 px, lines off the ink 6 px (line half-width 7.07 px)

checks.label: Solid black areas are small accents, not large fills
